headline: Games made to feel good.
intro: Dedicated to creating feel-good content, focusing on games that avoid forced ads, heavy monetization, and a pay-to-win model!
about: We believe games should be fun first. That means making room for satisfying progress and memorable adventures without aggressive monetization getting in the way.

principles.title: No forced ads
principles.description: Enjoy the adventure without being interrupted by ads you have to watch.

principles.title: No pay-to-win
principles.description: Progress should feel earned, not locked behind a purchase.

principles.title: Fun over monetization
principles.description: Thoughtful game experiences come before aggressive sales tactics.
